purpose: Native-netlist anchored repeatable screen for dual FOC local-rail loss/hold through a parameterized parking tail; this is not gate-drive or vehicle stop validation.

source.path: 电力/FOC驱动模块/eda工程文件/导出/当前交付/FOC_G431_P1.enet

drv8353rs.buck_architecture: TI DRV835x official datasheet identifies the integrated buck as LM5008A; internal packaged implementation is not interchangeable with standalone LM5008A external specifications without qualification

local_rails.5V_BUCK: DRV8353RS integrated Buck from BUS; its output currently disabled by native RT/SD clamp when LOAD_POWER_VALID path requests clamp
local_rails.MCU_3V3: WeAct core-board rail; native board provides 100nF CAN VIO decoupling only, core-board capacitance and load unknown
local_rails.SAFE_5V: BUS -> U2 TPS7A4001 -> SAFE_5V -> MCU ADC/COMP divider; no independent stored-energy source
local_rails.DUMP_5V: BUS -> U6 TPS7A4001 -> comparator rails U3/U7 and BOV chain; no independent stored-energy source

hall.signals: HALL_A/B/C have direct and divider paths; pullups to MCU_3V3; Hall device current and whether its VCC is powered during tail are not established

bms_loss_trigger.actual_physical_logic_and_timing: native topology verified; delivered waveform, voltage threshold, optocoupler transfer, transistor storage, and system loss ordering are not measured; no GPIO or firmware trigger assumed

bov.path: BUS -> U6 DUMP_5V -> U7 BUSOV_N -> Q_BOV_PNP/Q_BOV_NPN -> BREAK_N
bov.meaning: BOV commands hardware Break; it does not keep 5V_BUCK/MCU_3V3 alive and does not provide absorption power

candidate_pc6.evidence: J_MCU_L pin 9 has empty net; historical footprint evidence maps pin 9 to PC6. Candidate only pending exact WeAct core-board revision/pinout and isolated-use verification. No firmware or wiring is presumed.

parking_tail_interface.consumes: per-board BUS(t), LPV(t), 5V_BUCK(t), MCU_3V3(t), SAFE_5V(t), DUMP_5V(t), and actual standstill time from parent coupled vehicle model; feed parent BUS trace/stop time when available
parking_tail_interface.present_data_limit: existing vehicle co-simulation reports aggregate rows over a 5 s horizon but does not export BUS(t), local rail waveforms, MCU reset, Hall validity, or actual motor body-diode tail; this screen therefore exposes an input contract and capacitor/power bounds instead of inventing a shared time trace
parking_tail_interface.board_interference: run cases A hold only, B hold only, both hold, neither hold. Hardware input is shared LOAD_POWER_VALID; two boards share BUS/GND and one A-side 1k bias per population contract. Independent local holds must not source LOAD_POWER_VALID or each other; cross-current and ground displacement need bench measurement.

limits: No code or wiring maps PC6 or any other GPIO to local hold; candidate stuck-high can defeat cold-start/fault default-off unless a separate hardware actual-main-path interlock is proven.

366.554mA is a modeled inductor transient peak used only as a stress case; it is not a continuous load or steady hold budget. Buck startup current upper bound previously screened at 0.685A exceeds 0.610A maximum limit point; cold-start qualification remains open.
No 3V3 budget/capacitance, MCU BOR waveform, Hall sensor supply/current, SAFE/DUMP dropout trajectory, DRV8353 UVLO/shutdown behavior, gate VGS, torque, or regenerative diode current inferred here.

Local control power alone is insufficient to credit stopping torque: integrated vehicle model gives zero actual installed-FOC braking credit, and brake continuation after main path opens is counterfactual.

official_sources.note: TI DRV835x datasheet identifies the integrated buck architecture as LM5008A. Standalone LM5008A electrical limits are not automatically transferable to the integrated driver implementation.
